parameters.query:
-- Origenes posibles para una regla de alerta: tablas base + vistas "v_alert_*".
-- Cada vista declara en su COMMENT un JSON {"reference_table": "...", "label": "..."}
-- con la tabla real a la que apuntan las alert_instances que genera.
WITH sources AS (
    SELECT t.table_name,
           CASE WHEN t.table_type = 'VIEW' THEN 'view' ELSE 'table' END AS kind,
           d.description
    FROM information_schema.tables t
    LEFT JOIN pg_class pc
           ON pc.relname = t.table_name
          AND pc.relnamespace = 'public'::regnamespace
    LEFT JOIN pg_description d
           ON d.objoid = pc.oid
          AND d.objsubid = 0
          AND d.classoid = 'pg_class'::regclass
    WHERE t.table_schema = 'public'
      AND (
          t.table_type = 'BASE TABLE'
          OR (t.table_type = 'VIEW' AND t.table_name LIKE 'v\_alert\_%')
      )
),
meta AS (
    SELECT s.table_name,
           s.kind,
           CASE WHEN s.kind = 'view' AND pg_input_is_valid(s.description, 'jsonb')
                THEN s.description::jsonb END AS cfg
    FROM sources s
)
SELECT
    json_object_agg(
        m.table_name,
        (
            SELECT json_agg(
                json_build_object(
                    'name', c.column_name,
                    'type', c.data_type,
                    'is_nullable', c.is_nullable
                )
                ORDER BY c.ordinal_position
            )
            FROM information_schema.columns c
            WHERE c.table_name = m.table_name
              AND c.table_schema = 'public'
        )
    ) AS "tables",
    json_object_agg(
        m.table_name,
        json_build_object(
            'kind', m.kind,
            'reference_table', CASE
                WHEN m.kind = 'view' THEN COALESCE(m.cfg->>'reference_table', m.table_name)
                ELSE m.table_name
            END,
            'label', m.cfg->>'label'
        )
    ) AS "sources"
FROM meta m;

SELECT *
FROM public.alert_rules
WHERE id = $1
LIMIT 1;

SELECT *
FROM
    public.alert_rules
WHERE
    (
        $1 IS NULL
        OR name ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%'
        OR code ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%'
    )
    AND ($2 IS NULL OR is_active = $2)
ORDER BY
    created_at DESC
LIMIT $3
OFFSET $4;

SELECT ar.*
FROM public.alert_rules ar
WHERE ar.id = $1

WITH ins AS (
  INSERT INTO public.alert_instances (
    rule_id,
    reference_table,
    reference_id,
    patient_id,
    alert_date,
    event_date,
    title,
    priority,
    details_json,
    status,
    summary,
    occurrence_key
  )
  VALUES (
    $1, $2, $3, $4, $5,
    COALESCE(NULLIF($10::text, '')::timestamp, '{{ $now }}'::timestamp),
    $6, $7, $8,
    'PENDING', $9, $11
  )
  ON CONFLICT (rule_id, reference_table, reference_id, occurrence_key)
  DO NOTHING
  RETURNING *
),
-- Ocurrencia nueva del mismo registro (cambio la fecha del evento): las
-- alertas anteriores que nadie atendio quedan reemplazadas por esta.
superseded AS (
  UPDATE public.alert_instances o
  SET status = 'SUPPRESSED',
      notes = concat_ws(E'\n', NULLIF(o.notes, ''),
                        'Reemplazada por la alerta #' || ins.id || ': cambió la fecha del evento.'),
      updated_at = now()
  FROM ins
  WHERE $12::text <> 'state'
    AND o.rule_id = ins.rule_id
    AND o.reference_table = ins.reference_table
    AND o.reference_id = ins.reference_id
    AND o.id <> ins.id
    AND o.status = 'PENDING'
  RETURNING o.id
)
SELECT * FROM ins;
